scope: Article II and Annex B s 3 (Singapore Day, end of the Malaysian constitution in Singapore), Annex B s 6 (sovereignty), s 7 (existing laws continue), s 8 (courts and appeals to the Federal Court and Privy Council), s 9 (property and liabilities revert), s 10 (public officers), s 11 (2 Senators and 15 MPs), s 12 (citizenship), s 13 (treaties and international decisions), s 14 (Johore Water Agreements), Article VII (Annexes J and K rescinded) and Article VIII (indemnity for Malaysian guarantees). Not encoded: recitals, proclamations, Articles III-VI, Annex B ss 2, 4, 5, second paragraph of s 13.
